newsitem.title: USA: SEC chief's aide to join Smith Barney.
newsitem.headline: SEC chief's aide to join Smith Barney.

text.p: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commision said on Monday that Michael Schlein, chief of staff to SEC Chairman Arthur Levitt, would leave at the end of the year to become senior vice president at Travelers Group Inc affiliate Smith Barney.

At the Wall Street investment firm, Schlein will be director for corporate development and planning beginning early in 1997, a new position. He is to report to James Dimon, president and chief executive of the firm.
Schlein will be replaced by Jennifer Scardino, currently SEC director of public affairs.
Scardino joined the SEC in July 1993. She will begin her new job on December 23.
